name: Diagnostic Public Phase Visibility
description: The public diagnostic page renders different sections depending on the diagnostic phase. After admin sends initial phase (initial_sent_at set, status=SENT), only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both} appear. After admin sends final phase (final_sent_at set), sections with visibility='final' (e.g. executive_summary, cost, timeline) are also returned by the API and appear in the sidebar. E2E should mock two API responses (initial-phase vs final-phase) and assert which section types render in each state.
